design_archetype: Federal Swiss Tech / Precision Compliance Workbench

color_system.theme: Light theme body with Dark Navy Navigation Sidebar
color_system.synthetic_banner: bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs shadow-inner

typography.table_header: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 bg-slate-50

header.style: bg-slate-900 text-white border-b border-slate-800 px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
header.user_badge_style: bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs

sidebar.style: bg-[#0A1128] text-slate-300 flex flex-col h-full border-r border-slate-800
sidebar.system_selector: Persistent selector block at top with empty state indicator

synthetic_banner.text: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA – NOT FOR CUI/CLASSIFIED/OPERATIONAL DATA
synthetic_banner.style: bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 text-center py-1 px-4 text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase border-b border-amber-500 shadow-sm

login_page.style: Centered slate-900 gradient background container with dense federal security card styling

panels.detail_drawer: Slide-over drawer showing control statement, parameters, guidance, assessment objectives, and mapped CCIs
panels.content_versions: Pinned catalog version, baseline versions, CCI list version, SHA-256 hashes, and official source URLs

admin_page.ai_smoke_test: Admin-only test action triggering provider/model/latency check
admin_page.audit_events: Dense table of system audit log events with timestamp, user, action, and outcome
admin_page.rbac_demo: AO-only endpoint button displaying 403 Forbidden vs 200 OK status based on current active user role

phase_placeholders.rule: Honest placeholder state without fake interactive buttons

image_urls.description: Hardware security chip with verified compliance checkmark

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (inputs, buttons, select pickers, drawer toggles, table rows, tab triggers) and key data callouts MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="login-dev-user-select", data-testid="controls-table-search", data-testid="admin-ai-smoke-test-btn").
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure min 4.5:1 ratio for normal text on white cards, minimum 3:1 for status pills and dark sidebar navigation labels.
testing_and_accessibility.hover_states: Always set explicit text color on hover alongside background changes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color palette: Dark Navy left sidebar, Light gray page background, white cards, blue primary, amber warning, red critical, green success.
Always maintain the persistent Synthetic Data Banner at top of app layout.
Ensure all components are stored as JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files as per project structure.
Populate controls catalog drawer with detailed NIST SP 800-53 Rev5 metadata and CCI mappings.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive and key data display elements for testing.
Use lucide-react icons for UI elements throughout.
